day_shape: 59 items: CENTCOM enforcing announced US naval blockade against Iran (97 vessels redirected, 4 disabled), Trump reported moving toward strike order, Qatari and Pakistani mediators in Tehran, France drafting UN Hormuz resolution, fresh OFAC SDN action, IDF strikes across southern Lebanon and Bekaa.

threads.label: US-Iran war diplomacy and mediation
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Trump moving toward ordering strikes on Iran with no final decision made, while Qatari and Pakistani teams shuttled to Tehran and Rubio cited 'some progress' after NATO talks. Jerusalem Post reported Baghaei telling IRNA no deal is possible if Washington insists on discussing Iran's enriched uranium stockpile; Khamenei's office and Defa Press said Araghchi spoke with UN's Guterres, Oman's Al-Busaidi and Pakistan army chief Asim Munir.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz blockade and toll plans
threads.summary: CENTCOM posted imagery of US Navy enforcement of its blockade against Iranian ports, stating 97 commercial vessels redirected and 4 disabled, while France drafted a UN resolution to establish an international mission restoring Hormuz movement. Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel reported Iran negotiating with Oman on a Hormuz toll system despite US warnings, with a third Qatari LNG tanker transiting to China; Pentagon also paused a $14bn Taiwan arms package citing Iran-war constraints.

threads.label: IDF operations in southern Lebanon and Bekaa
threads.summary: IDF Arabic spokesperson Avichay Adraee announced overnight raids on an underground Hezbollah production site in the Bekaa and infrastructure in the Tyre area, plus a strike eliminating a Hezbollah cell in civilian homes. Adraee issued evacuation warnings for Tyre, Zqaq al-Mufadi and Borj Rahal villages citing ceasefire breaches; Times of Israel reported IDF killings of Hezbollah operatives and drones triggering border sirens.

threads.label: Sanctions enforcement and evasion
threads.summary: OFAC published a Federal Register notice adding persons and vessels to the SDN list, while Times of Israel reported that a sanctioned Iranian businessman helped the regime skirt sanctions via a crypto exchange. Jerusalem Post carried analysis describing Iran's two parallel economic systems as the reason decades of sanctions have not stopped its nuclear-threshold progress.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging: Raisi anniversary and Khorramshahr
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released a message marking the second anniversary of Raisi's death and the martyrs of service, alongside a sapling-planting initiative and solidarity-donation appeal. Defa Press ran multiple items framing the Khorramshahr liberation anniversary as a symbol of unity against threats and quoted Defence ministry spokesperson Talainik saying refusal to yield to Iran's rights will bring 'further defeats for Trump'.

Infrastructure belonging to the Hezbollah terrorist organisation in the Tyre area, which it used to plan and execute terrorist schemes against IDF forces, was also targeted.

The vessels placed on the SDN List have been identified as property in which a blocked person has an interest.
